name: CATALYST_SYMBOL_IMPACT_READER_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: CATALYST_SYMBOL_IMPACT_READER_20261107 — catalyst_symbol_impact held accurate per-symbol
impact rows and no operator-facing surface read them. The lane has written them since 2026-09-15
(10,306 rows; 126 on 2026-11-06, matching its receipt) and the only readers were news_symbol_guard
scripts/lib/catalyst_impact_reader.py is the reader behind GET /api/v3/catalyst/symbol-impact
CatalystImpactPanel.tsx renders it in the live watch card detail, and
The gate pins: rows are typed for the page (Decimals and timestamps converted, direction
normalised); every user value travels as a driver parameter and neither statement is anything but
SELECT; a non-ticker symbol is refused before any SQL runs; days/limit are bounded; an empty window
says when the writer last recorded something (no_rows_in_window) and a symbol the writer never saw
says no_rows — neither is presented as '0 catalysts'; and a failed read is a 500, never an empty 200.
Hermetic: a fake DB callable records every statement. No database, no network.
